entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the VeloFit cycling shoes. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They're awful. I've tried them three times and they've given me terrible blisters right around the ball of my foot.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is key for a good ride. Just to confirm, is the issue with the shoe itself or perhaps the placement of the cleats?
The shoe. The hard plate for the cleats feels like it's in the wrong spot. I just want a refund.

Of course. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment... Okay, I see the delivery was 37 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window for a full refund.
Fine. About time something was simple.

I understand completely. I've gone ahead and initiated that return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file for you now. And Sarah, I also see you're a VIP member with VeloFit. To apologize for the trouble with the shoes, I've added a $20 credit to your account for any future purchase.
Whatever. Just make sure the label actually shows up.

It has just been sent. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed immediately. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
